_comment: Version-controlled consult evaluation cases. Each case has a baseline 'expect' describing today's bar and, where behaviour is gated on an implementation milestone, a 'milestones' map of per-milestone overrides. 'stepN' milestones are cumulative: running at stepN applies every stepM override with M <= N, in order (an override replaces the keys it names). 'answerable' records whether the question has an answer in the snapshot/notes at all, so an abstention can be counted as a false abstention. 'observed' records a deployed consult's behaviour; the frozen response is in fixtures/observed/<id>.json (replay mode). 'scripted' names a canned model answer (fixtures/scripted/) that scripted mode runs through the live pipeline: for E1-E3 a correct answer written from the evidence retrieval now presents, for E5-E6 and E8 the answer the tier contract allows, and for E7 and E9-E12 a reproduction of an observed wrong answer, whose expectation is that the pipeline flags it. 'now', 'branch_states' and 'caller' freeze what tiering reads.

cases.question: Which QA rounds does Master Agent Dispatch run, their branch prefixes, and the open-PR limit?

observed.summary: 'Not documented' even though three relevant memories were retrieved; .github/CLAUDE.md was not in the corpus.

cases.question: What does validate-agent-commit.sh block and what exit code does it use?

observed.summary: Right description; 'exit 2' cited to claude-code-job.md:330 (the detect-test-hiding.sh section). Real value is 'exit 3', in the script alone.

cases.question: Where does ObjectOrientedDesignRule record its verdicts?

observed.summary: Guessed from an unrelated April memory about runCorrectionSession; surfaced April memories naming ClaudeCodeJob (deleted 2026-05-16). Real answer .flowtree/oop-review.md is in no document.
'Not documented' — correct abstention. No such script exists anywhere in the tree.

cases.question: Why can't ar-secrets secret_render_file render the openrouter-api-key secret?

observed.summary: Namespace widening: the fact is only in a 'decisions' namespace note, which a default-only search never reaches.

cases.question: How long does a consult conversation stay open when it is idle?

observed.summary: Conflict: two branch-local notes from different open branches give different idle expiries; the answer must report both, not pick one.

cases.question: Does consult support streaming partial answers on master?

observed.summary: Branch-local: the feature exists only on an unmerged branch. The scripted answer asserts it without naming the branch, which must be flagged.

History: the rationale is only in a five-month-old note naming a deleted class. It belongs in 'history', never as present-tense fact. No present-tense answer exists in the snapshot or in a current note, so a full answer is an abstention with the rationale in 'history' (answerable: false).

cases.question: Which QA rounds does Master Agent Dispatch run, their branch prefixes, and the open-PR limit?

observed.summary: After .github/ was indexed, consult answered but invented the branch prefixes (deployed response: qa/doc-qa, qa/defect-hunt, ...; reported on 2026-10-19: project/doc-*, project/defect-*, ...). The real ones are qa/docs-, qa/defect-, ... The scripted answer reproduces the reported variant, attributed to the chunk that lists the real prefixes.

cases.question: Which files need a ci/ branch to change, and how can another branch be authorised to change them?

observed.summary: Lock paths and bypass concept right, but the reported answer invented an example trailer 'Sensitive-File-Bypass: signed-by-controller'; the real format is 'Sensitive-File-Bypass: <job-id>=<signature>' (check-ci-file-lock.sh header). Note: .github/actions/ IS in check-ci-file-lock.sh's LOCKED_PATH_PATTERN, although the script's header comment and tools/ci/README.md name only .github/workflows/ and tools/ci/, so naming it is not penalised.

cases.question: What does validate-agent-commit.sh block and what exit code does it use?

observed.summary: Still 'exit 2', now justified by a 2026-09-16 note that was true when written: the script moved to exit 3 on 2026-09-24. The note is 33 days old and on a merged branch, so it tiers as current; only the snapshot index's exit-code fact contradicts it.

cases.question: Where does ObjectOrientedDesignRule record its verdicts?

observed.summary: Reported: 'one class per job' (it is one session per changed class, up to 12) and a guessed verdict location (real: .flowtree/oop-review.md). The exact guessed path was not recorded; the scripted answer uses a representative one. 'one class per job' carries no checkable name, so the token verifier cannot catch it; that expectation records the gap.
